title: Push notifications - Scenario 21
preconditions_original: Notifications service available and ready for operations
expected_results_original: System correctly handles push notifications scenario
business_context: Validates that the platform can proactively inform users about important events through mobile or web push notifications without disruption to their normal usage.
functional_intent: Ensures that when a push notification is triggered, it is generated, queued, and delivered correctly to the target user/device, and that the application displays it as expected without errors.
searchable_summary: Verifies end-to-end push notification delivery so that triggered notifications are correctly generated, routed, and displayed to users according to their preferences.

title: Email notifications - Scenario 22
preconditions_original: Valid session and user is on Notifications page
expected_results_original: System correctly handles email notifications scenario
business_context: Confirms that users receive timely and accurate email communications such as alerts, confirmations, and updates related to their account or transactions.
functional_intent: Validates that when an email notification is triggered, the system composes the correct content, addresses it to the right recipient, sends it via the email provider, and records the outcome without errors.
searchable_summary: Tests that email notifications are correctly generated, sent, and logged so users reliably receive system emails for events and actions.

title: Price calculation - Scenario 23
preconditions_original: Pricing service available and ready for operations
expected_results_original: System correctly handles price calculation scenario
business_context: Ensures that customers see accurate prices for products or services, including any applicable taxes, fees, or discounts, before completing a purchase.
functional_intent: Verifies that the pricing engine correctly computes final prices based on base price, quantity, discounts, and tax rules, and returns consistent values to consuming channels.
searchable_summary: Checks that the pricing service accurately calculates final product prices using configured rules for discounts and taxes and returns consistent values to clients.

title: Apply coupon - Scenario 24

expected_results_original: System correctly handles apply coupon scenario
business_context: Validates that customers can successfully apply promotional coupons to reduce their payable amount during a purchase.

title: Support 10k users - Scenario 27

searchable_summary: Performs a load test simulating 10k concurrent users to verify that core application flows remain performant and stable under high traffic.

searchable_summary: Tests database failover handling to ensure the application can switch to a standby database with preserved data integrity and minimal disruption.
